input.query: SELECT s.sop_id, s.title, s.doc_ver, s.effective_dt, s.process_step FROM pd.sop s WHERE s.sop_id IN ('SOP-MFG-101','SOP-MFG-102','SOP-MFG-103','SOP-MFG-104','SOP-MFG-105','SOP-MFG-106','SOP-MAT-401') ORDER BY 1;
SELECT sys_id, sys_name, sys_class, gamp_cat, gxp_area, val_status FROM pd.val_system ORDER BY sys_id;
